final: WITH d AS (SELECT c.district_id, di.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n FROM client c JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id GROUP BY c.district_id, di.A3) SELECT district_id, region, n AS num_clients, 1.0 * n / SUM(n) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS frac_of_region, 1.0 * n / SUM(n) OVER () AS frac_of_total FROM d ORDER BY frac_of_total DESC, district_id LIMIT 10
